Catalyst is an AI-agent platform for researching markets and automating trading strategies. You describe a trading idea in plain language, and Catalyst researches it, builds a strategy with trading conditions, monitors the events that could trigger it, and trades for you. It covers spot tokens, perpetual futures, tokenized stocks and prediction markets, drawing on market data, news, social activity and sentiment. Agents trade through non-custodial wallets (powered by Privy) within limits you approve, and strategies can be paused or changed at any time. Catalyst raised a $30M seed round led by Sequoia, with participation from Jump, Lux Capital, AntiFund, Selini Capital, Peak XV Partners and SF1. There is no token or points program yet, and access is currently through a waitlist.
